title: Malicious code in dowload_ebok_nur_mal_schnell_das_mammut_retten_by_knut_kruger_eva_schoffmann_davidov_ouz6t (npm)
description: The npm package 'dowload_ebok_nur_mal_schnell_das_mammut_retten_by_knut_kruger_eva_schoffmann_davidov_ouz6t' contains malicious code that compromises any computer on which it is installed or run. The compromise is severe enough that all secrets and keys stored on the affected system should be considered exposed and require immediate rotation from a different, uncompromised machine. Removing the package alone does not guarantee removal of all malicious software introduced by it.
